title: Flight Attendants Aren't Drink Servers — They're Safety Crew ✈️
description:
That friendly hello at the aircraft door is only the beginning. Flight attendants train for evacuation, cabin fire, first aid, and medical response—and the famous 90-second evacuation is a certification test standard, not a promise for every real accident. Even the pay clock is more complicated than it looks, with traditional block-time systems changing airline by airline.

Sources:
FAA — https://www.faa.gov/safety/people
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — https://www.bls.gov/ooh/transportation-and-material-moving/flight-attendants.htm
